meta.title: An ordinary eRFX project never offers BOQ templates
gaps: Enable or verify the boq_in_erfx_allowed tenant gate and provision the BOQ and ordinary template fixtures.
Read the GET /templates?type_identifier=trade response and compare its template identities and BOQ classifications with the complete picker contents.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Enable or verify the boq_in_erfx_allowed tenant gate and provision the BOQ and ordinary template fixtures.; Read the GET /templates?type_identifier=trade response and compare its template identities and BOQ classifications with the complete picker contents.

steps.note: Open an ordinary eRFX project, not the BOQ creation path; its default Auction stage is a pricing stage.
Supply the required unique title for this create-screen test.
Open the pricing-stage template picker without selecting a template.
Confirm the picker is visible before checking for excluded labels.
Assert no BOQ label is visible in the open picker.
Verify the picker requested trade templates successfully; this does not compare the response contents with the picker.
